text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(What incredible depth of competition...! 
They're not gonna let me win easy—)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I was riding such a good wave right up 
until today, and then I let the win slip 
away...! What was I thinking getting so 
full of myself...?!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose next time... Not to anyone, 
ever!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(You're really somethin' else, pal...! The 
way I see it, you were definitely the 
scariest one out there today.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Honestly, there's no doubt bad luck 
played a part in your loss. But you... you 
refuse to make any excuses for it...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"That immense thirst for victory...! I've 
learned a lot from it too...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"And in next year's 'Takarazuka Kinen'— 
I'm going to win...!"
